description: This file defines configuration handling for environment variables and a basic API client placeholder within a Flutter project. It includes classes EnvConfig for environment variables management and ApiClient for future HTTP request implementations.

classes.name: EnvConfig
classes.description: Provides environment-based configuration values such as API URLs, WebSocket URLs, feature flags, and optional API keys.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Placeholder for an API client that would handle network requests; currently unimplemented.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for REST API, either from environment variables or a default local host URL.

methods.name: wsBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for WebSocket connections, either from environment variables or a default local host URL.

methods.name: useMocks
methods.description: Determines if mock services should be used based on environment variable FEATURE_USE_MOCKS.

methods.name: stripePublishableKey
methods.description: Retrieves the Stripe publishable key from environment variables, or empty string if not set.

methods.name: ApiClient
methods.description: Constructor for ApiClient class; currently a placeholder that throws UnimplementedError on network request.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Asynchronous method intended to perform HTTP GET requests; currently throws an error as unimplemented.
